notes: The baseline WASM was built from an isolated git archive of 6e1754e; the same current guards ran against both builds.
Compilation coverage is not numerical correctness coverage. Unsupported minimum-feature/default-limit specializations are explicit skips.
Guard metricMs values are diagnostic wall/GPU times, not production inference latency or evidence of a speedup.
The model replay is one pass of 36 synthetic Kevala cases in three option orders. Its 1188 calls are not 1188 independent examples or the full README campaign.
Model catalog SHA-256 values identify expected packs; the fresh model replay did not separately verify full-download hashes.
The single near-boundary SemIf-2B decision change is retained. Older README measurements remain pinned to their original build.
Kev-9B initially failed during download/setup with network error. A fresh retry completed all decisions; the failed attempt is retained.
